label: Notification Stack
description: Stack of notifications sliding in from a corner with type-specific accent colors.

fill.label: true makes the cards fill the component's box: no 40px corner inset, the box's width (default: a 380px column in the corner) -- for a card placed by geometry, so it lines up with its box.

hold.label: true keeps the cards up to the cut (default: they slide out half a second before the scene ends) -- for a stack that lands late in the scene, or one its own exit takes off.

surface.label: glass (default: a translucent card for dark screens) | solid (an opaque white card with dark type -- over a person or a light plate)
